citations.section: Prop. 54.4980H-5(f)(1)-(3), (f)(7)(vii); reliance statement at 84 FR 51484: taxpayers may rely on the proposed section 4980H rules for plan years beginning before six months after final rules; eCFR 54.4980H-5 has no paragraph (f) as of 2026-11-05

value.summary: The lowest cost silver plan may be taken for the rating area of the employee's primary site of employment; a remote employee with no site to report to uses the residence.
Applicable age is the age on the first day of the plan year, or on the date the HRA can first take effect for an employee who becomes eligible later.
For the paragraph (f) safe harbors the plan is identified at the lowest age band and priced at the employee's applicable age.
Calendar-year plan: January of the prior calendar year; other plan years: January of the current calendar year.
Required HRA contribution for the calendar year does not exceed the required contribution percentage of Form W-2 box 1 wages from the employer.
